The next London SynBio Network event will be on Thursday the 14th of May. As usual, we will have 2x20 mins talks, followed by networking over drinks and snacks:

🧫 Design, cloning, and competitive growth screening of CRISPRi and protein variant libraries to study yeast killer toxins.

🌱 Evolving biological nitrogen fixation with microbial co-cultures
Amir Guppy (Isalan Lab | Imperial College london)

📍 Location and time: Thursday the 14th of May at 18:00, Sherfield Building, Room 324, Sherfield Building, Imperial College Union, Prince Consort Rd, South Kensington, London SW7 2BB (see this link to see how to get there). The event has step-free access and is open to anyone, but please register so reception has your details.

➡️ Register at: https://events.humanitix.com/london-synbio-network-16

🧬 London SynBio Network is organised by Early Career Researchers and hosts monthly meetups to bring Synbio folks from academia and industry together, providing an informal space to share ideas and ask for advice.
